q1_issues.issue: The decomposition atom (Inheritance coal_fired_plant plant) is kept inside the attitude seal, but definitional decomposition atoms of compounds P mentions must project out to top level, so the genus link is never asserted.

q2_gaps: Specificational nominal attitude "X's hope is that P" — the attitude sections cover attitude verbs, not a copular clause whose subject is an attitude noun taking the that-clause as predicate.

Attributive / elided-standard comparatives ("older ... plants", "more power", "more cheaply") have no licensed form, so the increase-and-cheaper point of the hope is unencodable; the instruction set itself registers this as drop-and-record-the-gap.
notes: The em-dash appositive is handled correctly as (Most affected sk_plant_1 segment) plus the required class membership (Member sk_plant_1 segment), and the non-factive seal keeps every predication of P off top level. Possession for "the efficiency of ... plants" is defensible, since no underlying verb makes the of-phrase an object.
